Compare a first-time viewer's understanding of a promo clip with the truth.
TRUTH (from the show bible, for episodes E14): Premise: [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
Mayor Brisk (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 53 lines between E1 and E14
Selene (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 46 lines between E1 and E14
Corin (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 37 lines between E1 and E14
Mara (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 28 lines between E1 and E14
Arc [mock] Part 4: A storm traps the whole family in the lighthouse overnight.
E14: The truth about the night Corin drowned comes out on the quay.
CLIP: [On screen: Close-up on the widow's hands gripping the rail.]
[Action: the widow draws a short blade from a boot.]
a figure in period dress: "Say her name again and you will regret it."
[On screen: Low angle on the widow framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a figure in period dress: "The council has already decided her fate."
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
[On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
[On screen: Medium two-shot of the figure in period dress and the figure in period dress, the space between them charged.]
a figure in period dress: "The council has already decided her fate."
[On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the figure in period dress toward the figure in period dress.]
[Action: the figure in period dress grabs the figure in period dress by the wrist.]
a figure in period dress: "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress: "Is this mercy, or is it another trap?"
[On screen: Close-up on the man in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
[Action: the man in period dress grabs the figure in period dress by the wrist.]
a figure in period dress: "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
[On screen: Low angle on the figure in period dress framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a figure in period dress: "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
